ValidationRule.description: Validation rule created for respecting the required format for the field ER_VAT_Number__c.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c) && ER_SmartER_Context__c= True && NOT(ISBLANK(ER_VAT_Number__c)) && ISPICKVAL( ER_Country_Code__c , 'FR') && NOT( REGEX( ER_VAT_Number__c, "[0-9]{11}") || REGEX( ER_VAT_Number__c, "[^IO]{1}[0-9]{10}") || REGEX( ER_VAT_Number__c, "[^IO]{2}[0-9]{9}") || REGEX( ER_VAT_Number__c, "FR[0-9A-Z]{2}[0-9]{9}") || REGEX( ER_VAT_Number__c, "[0-9]{1}[^IO]{1}[0-9]{9}") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The VAT field must have the following structure “FR + 2 check digits + 9 digits”
